scoring_justification: The main result is four energy splittings that are direct outputs of heavy quantum chemical calculations. Recomputing those calculations inside the verifier is infeasible; result-level comparison against the paper's reported numbers with permissive tolerances is the appropriate tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference LS-HS energy splittings (eV) at four levels of theory
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the paper: Fig.1 and the reasoning steps give cas5=1.26, cas7=0.87, mrci7=0.18, mrci11=-0.006. The reference solution uses these exact numbers.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly taken from the paper's textual descriptions of the splittings.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published values; the checker must compare the agent's computed splittings to these authentic references.

outputs.description: The four HS–LS energy splittings computed at successive levels of theory. Positive values indicate HS lower in energy; negative values indicate LS lower.

output_contract.notes: The scoring will compare each splitting to reference values from the paper with appropriate tolerances and check that the MRCI-11 splitting has the correct sign (LS ground state).
